title: Scattering Transform Based Image Clustering using Projection onto Orthogonal Complement
venueFull: ACM Workshop on Intelligent Cross-Data Analysis and Retrieval (ICDAR) at ICMR
summary: Proposes Projected-Scattering Spectral Clustering (PSSC), an interpretable image clustering method. It projects scattering-transform features onto the orthogonal complement of subspaces shared across classes, then applies spectral clustering. PSSC is the best shallow method and over 10x faster than comparable deep methods.
